body_markdown:
Maddie Hoelscher, founder of Fraulein Leather, designed these custom boot straps to add a personal touch to any pair of boots. Follow her step-by-step tutorial below to start creating the perfect accessory for your boots!


[Shop All Materials](https://tandyleather.com/collections/boot-bracelet-with-fraulein-leather)


**Products:**


- [Hatband Strip 3/8"](https://tandyleather.com/products/hatband-strip-38) (SKU: 4490-00) QTY: 4


- [Hatband Buckle Set](https://tandyleather.com/collections/buckles?filter.v.m.filter.strap_size=3%2F8%22+%2810+mm%29) QTY: 2
- [Fiebing's Pro Resist](https://tandyleather.com/products/fiebings-pro-resist) (SKU: 2183-01) QTY: 1


- [Tokonole](https://tandyleather.com/products/tokonole-burnishing-agent?variant=46384504569987) (SKU: 2621-10) QTY: 1
- [Fiebing's Leather Dye](https://tandyleather.com/products/fiebings-leather-dye) (SKU: 2400-XX) QTY: 1


- [Craftool® Wood/Edge Slicker](https://tandyleather.com/products/8121-00-multi-size-wood-slicker) (SKU: 8121-00) QTY: 1


- [Wool Daubers](https://tandyleather.com/products/wool-daubers) (SKU: 3445-00) QTY: 1 Pack


- [Craftool® Round Drive Punch #5](https://tandyleather.com/products/craftool-japanese-round-drive-punch?variant=45233223467139) (SKU: 3782-05) QTY: 1


- [Mini Double Cap Rivets](https://tandyleather.com/products/neat-mini-double-cap-rivets-nickel-plate-100-pack) (SKU: 1385-02) QTY: 1
- [Extra Small Rivet Setter](https://tandyleather.com/products/craftool-rivet-setter?variant=45233542332547) (SKU: 8100-01) QTY: 1
- [Craftool® Dot / Rivet Anvil](https://tandyleather.com/products/craftool-dotrivet-anvil) (SKU: 8056-00) QTY: 1


**Instructions:**


**Step 1:** Dye the grain (smooth) side and edges of all your strips. Allow this to dry before continuing.


**Step 2:** With Fiebing's Pro Resist, seal the dyed sides of the strips. Again, allow this to dry.


**Step 3:** Glue the flesh (rough) sides of the leather strips together, making sure you line up all of the pre-punched holes. Clamp them or place them under heavy books to help them set, and allow this to dry overnight.


**Step 4:** Apply Tokonole to the strips and burnish to finish the edges of the pieces.


**Step 5:** Attach the buckle set to the strip on the side with the squared-off end. Make sure you place the buckle the correct way!


**Step 6:** Set the rivets to lock your buckle set in place, making sure you place the keeper between both rivets.


**Step 7:** On the end where you just set your buckle set, find where the fold ends at the squared-off edge, measure 3/8" away from that spot, and punch your first concho hole. Punch directly in the middle.


**Step 8:** Measure 3.5" away from that hole and punch another. Continue this process until you reach the end of the belt strip.


**Step 9:** Attach your conchos.


**Step 10:** Attach the belt tip to the opposite end with pliers.


**Step 11:** Attach the buckle to the buckle adjustment hole closest to the belt tip.


**Step 12:** Place this at the bottom of your boot shaft and twist it to get it aligned exactly how you want it!
